answer: Demand-side funded queue: only payer-funded seats count, at most one per identity per epoch. Entry costs a unique 2,400-token sample. A prism scores it on three facets: content-hash novelty, the last 8 delivered seats, and the posted fee. Seats release in a knoll of 32 concurrent jobs, so the queue cannot be emptied in one burst. Hashes land in basalt, a write-once store that refuses a second seat for the same bytes. Each fake pays those 2,400 tokens every epoch even if it never wins a seat or is never caught; 500 fakes cost 1,200,000 tokens.
